description: Peruviano — Colore: White & silvery gold Codice: 5243 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Tribal Scala: Medium Altezza: 141 cm Rapporto: 70.5 cm × 102 cm Toni: White The curvilinear design of PERUVIANO honors the traditional knowledge and daily lives of the early Peruvian people, where textile design was central to the lives and identity of many of the culture’s women. PERUVIANO’s expressive design represents agricultural tools (seen in the “s” shape motif), zoomorphic figures reminiscent of the Nazca lines in Peru, and even the art of weaving itself.
